podcast.title: Cancon Boosted Success (1970s)
podcast.body: Saga was among the Canadian rock bands that saw their careers benefit from the implementation of Cancon rules in the 1970s, contributing to their national and potential international success. "Just on the rock side, we had Rush, April Wine, the Guess Who, Triumph, Crobar, Teenage Head, Max Webster, Chilowac, FM, Saga, and a foot-and-cold water."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Christian Samson's Short Stint
podcast.body: Drummer Christian Samson, previously with Glüleg, had a "short stint" with Saga, identified as a "Prog Rock Group." This connection highlights his diverse collaborations within the rock genre. "There was also a short stint in Moist and with saga, the Prague Rock Group."
